svg.title: Share of days with net CO2 uptake (daily NEE < 0) per site-year, over the whole year and over the 90-day window with the largest GPP sum of the year.
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart of 16 site-years (full and reliable years), grouped by site, the same layout as Figure 2. Per site-year, the left bar (full site colour) is the share of days with daily NEE < 0 over the whole year, the right bar (lighter, hatched) the share inside the 90 consecutive local days with the largest GPP sum of the year (80 or more days with GPP); y axis days with net uptake (%), 0 to 100, dotted line at 50 %. Mean ± SD (range) of the peak window: Finnish sites 78 % ± 7 % (68 % to 91 %, n = 15), grassland 79 % ± 7 % (68 % to 91 %, n = 11), annual crops 76 % ± 7 % (69 % to 83 %, n = 5), annual crops without Maktau 75 % ± 8 % (69 % to 83 %, n = 4). Per site-year: Anttila 2022: 36 % of the year, window 2022-05-24 to 2022-08-21 79 % (mean measured fraction 0.64); Anttila 2023: 36 % of the year, window 2023-05-10 to 2023-08-07 86 % (mean measured fraction 0.70); Särkisuo 2022: 29 % of the year, window 2022-06-10 to 2022-09-07 74 % (mean measured fraction 0.56); Särkisuo 2023: 31 % of the year, window 2023-07-10 to 2023-10-07 68 % (mean measured fraction 0.54); Haltiala 2022 oats: 24 % of the year, window 2022-05-19 to 2022-08-16 69 % (mean measured fraction 0.69); Haltiala 2023 grass (failed): 25 % of the year, window 2023-05-09 to 2023-08-06 86 % (mean measured fraction 0.68); Haltiala 2024 sunflower: 24 % of the year, window 2024-06-27 to 2024-09-24 83 % (mean measured fraction 0.65); Haltiala 2025 oats: 18 % of the year, window 2025-05-28 to 2025-08-25 69 % (mean measured fraction 0.73); Qvidja 2020: 37 % of the year, window 2020-05-07 to 2020-08-04 83 % (mean measured fraction 0.27); Qvidja 2022: 29 % of the year, window 2022-05-18 to 2022-08-15 77 % (mean measured fraction 0.40); Qvidja 2023: 27 % of the year, window 2023-05-18 to 2023-08-15 71 % (mean measured fraction 0.36); Qvidja 2024: 32 % of the year, window 2024-06-01 to 2024-08-29 73 % (mean measured fraction 0.43); Qvidja 2025: 28 % of the year, window 2025-05-07 to 2025-08-04 83 % (mean measured fraction 0.29); Viikki 2024: 36 % of the year, window 2024-06-15 to 2024-09-12 91 % (mean measured fraction 0.28); Viikki 2025 faba bean: 27 % of the year, window 2025-06-14 to 2025-09-11 80 % (mean measured fraction 0.15); Maktau 2019 maize: 87 % of the year, window 2019-10-03 to 2019-12-31 81 % (mean measured fraction 0.75).
